# 3d Shadowrocket config, mtvpn import: contract

**Read first:** [build README → Phase 3](./README.md#phase-3-routing), [Shadowrocket config](../processes/routing/shadowrocket-config.md), [Shadowrocket integration](../integrations/shadowrocket.md), [mtvpn import](../processes/routing/mtvpn-import.md), [architecture → HTTP surfaces](../architecture.md#http-surfaces), designs `RP-Shadowrocket`, `RP-Shadowrocket-config`, `RP-Import`, `RP-Lists`, and the **As built** of 3a–3c and 2b (the token pattern, Reveal / Copy / QR, the public fetch and its recording, `httpx.MaskPath`).

**Done when:** Shadowrocket configs can be created (name, routing list, rule policy, base config pasted, uploaded or imported once from a URL), served at `GET /r/{token}/{name}.conf` exactly as the integration doc says (the base byte for byte, the list's rules spliced into `[Rule]` before `FINAL`, after ownership), previewed, given new base versions (with diff and restore), another list or policy, a new token, disabled and enabled, and deleted; every `GET` is recorded; `mtvpn.yaml` can be imported in three steps (paste → preview with choices → result) without its credentials ever being stored; the lists page offers the import and the list page shows its Shadowrocket targets; every checklist line has its test.

Not in 3d: routers (3e). A config needs no sync: every fetch renders the current state.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Service | `shadowrocket.Service` (Deps: DB, Vault, Events, `Lists`, `Fetch`, `Now`, `BaseURL`, Log). `Module.Shadowrocket`. | Build README layout. |
| Rules | `shadowrocket.Rules(view lists.View) []Block`: for each member in list order, its owned names (`own.Compute` with no exclusion), minus every name another **rule of the config** covers, as mtvpn's `shadowrocket_rules` did: a suffix name with a proper parent among all the config's suffix names, an exact name equal to or under one of them. Inside a block: `DOMAIN-SUFFIX` names sorted, then `DOMAIN` names sorted. A service left with nothing gets no block. | shadowrocket.md#output; Build README defaults. |
| Merge | `shadowrocket.Render(base []byte, list string, blocks []Block, policy string, at time.Time) ([]byte, error)`: lines are split **keeping their terminators**. `start` = the first line whose trimmed text equals `[rule]` in any case (none → `ErrNoRule`); `end` = the next line matching `^\[[^\]]+\]$` when trimmed, or the end; `final` = the first line in between whose trimmed text starts with `FINAL,` in any case; the insertion point is `final`, or `end` without one, then moved up over blank lines while it is below `start + 1`. Inserted, with the base's line ending (`\r\n` when its first line ends so, else `\n`): an empty line, `# Services from routing list "Main", by Proxier (2026-10-05 04:12 UTC)` (the render time, UTC, to the minute), then per block an empty line, `# <tag>` and its rules `DOMAIN-SUFFIX,<name>,<policy>` / `DOMAIN,<name>,<policy>`; without a `FINAL` line, `FINAL,DIRECT` after them, and an empty line too when the insertion point is a section header. Everything else is copied byte for byte; a base whose last line has no terminator gets one only where the block is appended after it. | shadowrocket.md; mtvpn's `shadowrocket_merge`; "copied byte for byte". |
| Base config | Must contain a `[Rule]` section (`ErrNoRule`: "no [Rule] section to add the services to"), at most 256 KiB, UTF-8. Nothing else is interpreted. Versions 1, 2, … with an optional note (≤ 200); **Save** makes a version only when the content changed; **Restore** of vN makes a new version with vN's content (note "restored from v2"). | shadowrocket-config.md "editing". |
| Editor | The user chose CodeMirror. The base config's field is a `textarea[data-code="shadowrocket"]` (the form works without JS) that the template editor's bundle enhances: `web/editor/editor.js` gains a second entry point, `initCodeAreas()`, which mounts CodeMirror **in a shadow root** (the CSP blocks the `<style>` tags CodeMirror writes on the document, 1b), with the editor's theme and keys, and copies the text back into the textarea on every change and before submit. A small `StreamLanguage` for Shadowrocket lives in `editor.js`: `[Section]` headers, comment lines (`#`, `;`), `key = value` lines, rule lines `TYPE,value[,policy]` (the type a keyword, e.g. `DOMAIN-SUFFIX`, `RULE-SET`, `FINAL`). `make editor` rebuilds `internal/platform/ui/static/js/editor.bundle.js` (committed; Docker must run), `make check-editor` stays green. The new-config and edit pages set `Shell.Scripts = js/editor.bundle.js`. | 1b's editor pattern. |
| Name and policy | Name: `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,62}$` (it is the file name `<name>.conf`), unique (`shadowrocket.err.name_taken`). Policy: trimmed, 1–64 characters, no comma, no line break (`PROXY` default; a proxy group's name works). | |
| Token and URL | As links (2b): `vault.NewToken()`, inserted with `token = X''` and `token_lookup = Vault.Lookup(token)`, then sealed with AAD `shadowrocket:<id>:token` in the same transaction. URL `<PROXIER_BASE_URL>/r/<token>/<name>.conf`. Only the config page holds it: masked (`…/r/` + 16 bullets + `/iphone.conf`), **Reveal** (htmx fragment, `no-store`), **Copy** (primary, `y`, the URL in `data-copy`), **QR** (htmx fragment, `no-store`). | Build README "Secrets". |
| Serving | `GET` and `HEAD /r/:token/:file` on `r.Public`: (1) the platform's limiter; (2) the token matches `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,64}$`, is found, the config is enabled, and `file` equals `<name>.conf`; otherwise the plain public `404` and nothing recorded; (3) render: the current base version, `lists.View` of its list, `Rules`, `Render` with its policy and now; (4) `GET` only: one `Write` inserting the fetch (`ip` = `c.RealIP()`, `user_agent` cut to 256 characters) and the config's `last_fetch_at`/`last_fetch_ua`; a failed write is logged (never the token) and the answer still goes out; (5) `200`, `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8` (the public chain adds `no-store` and `X-Robots-Tag`), the body (`HEAD`: no body). | shadowrocket-config.md "serving". |
| Edits | **Change routing list or policy…** (one page, both fields) → `routing.shadowrocket_updated{changes: "list, policy"}` with what changed; **Regenerate URL…** (strength 2: "The old URL stops working at once. Paste the new one into Shadowrocket.") → `changes: token`; **Disable…** (strength 2: "The URL answers 404 until you enable it; Shadowrocket keeps its last config.") / **Enable** → `changes: disabled` / `enabled`; a new base version → `changes: base, version: N`. An edit that changes nothing records nothing. | shadowrocket-config.md steps. |
| Delete | **Delete…** strength 2 ("Delete iphone? Its URL answers 404; its versions and fetch log go too."). `routing.shadowrocket_deleted{name}`. | Build README defaults (a config can be deleted). |
| Import from URL | On the new-config and edit pages, a URL field with **Import** fetches the base once (`http`/`https`, interactive deadline, 256 KiB) into the textarea; nothing is saved until **Create** / **Save**. | shadowrocket-config.md step 1. |
| Preview | "What the phone gets": the exact rendered output in a scroll area, Proxier's block marked (class `sr-ours`, a foam bar), base lines muted, plus **Download iphone.conf** (an admin route serving the same bytes as an attachment). Rendering it records nothing. | shadowrocket-config.md "Preview". |
| Fetch log | Time, IP, the user agent ("Shadowrocket/2.2.62 CFNetwork/…" shown as given); the newest 50 and **Older →**; "kept 90 days". The prune job deletes fetches older than 90 days. | data-model.md#retention. |
| Lists | `lists.Targets` returns the configs following a list (name, "fetched 20 min ago" / "never fetched", disabled); the list page's Targets area shows them ("iphone · Shadowrocket · fetched 20 min ago · gets the change on its next fetch"); a list's delete already moves them (3b, through `store`). | 3b. |
| mtvpn parser | `mtvpn.Parse(text) (File, error)` follows mtvpn's `parse_yaml`: blank lines and lines starting with `#` skipped; `- item` belongs to the last key (none → error); otherwise `key: value` split at the first `:` (no `:` → error); a value in matching quotes loses them; an empty `services:` line means an empty list. Only `services`, `service_lists` and `shadowrocket_base` are kept; every other key's **name** goes into `Ignored` and its value is dropped inside `Parse`. Errors name the line number only ("line 7 is not 'key: value'"), never its text. At most 64 KiB. | mtvpn-import.md step 2: credentials are never stored. |
| Service lists | Each `service_lists` entry must be an `http`/`https` URL ("a path on your computer can't be read here; paste its lines into services: instead"); fetched with the interactive deadline; read as mtvpn's `read_service_list`: a `#` at the start of a line or after whitespace starts a comment, a leading `- ` is dropped, a line ending with `:` is skipped, a line with whitespace inside is an error for that list, a list with no entry is an error. A failing list is reported with its error; its entries are missing and the rest stays importable. | mtvpn-import.md step 3. |
| Rows | In mtvpn's order: the config's `services` first, then each list's entries. Deduplicated by tag, the first spelling wins. Each row: the selector as Proxier stores it (bare names become `v2fly:`), its tag, where it came from (`services` or the list's file name), and a status: **new**; **exists** (a service has that tag: it is reused, shown with its selector); **invalid** (the selector doesn't parse: the error; not importable). URL rows have the choice **Keep as URL source** (default) / **Copy into a custom service**. Every importable row is ticked by default. | mtvpn-import.md step 4. |
| Preview step | `POST /routing/import` with the text (textarea or uploaded file): parse, fetch the lists and the base, build the rows, store a `routing_imports` row (`state = preview`; rows, ignored key names, the fetched base and its URL; the default list) and redirect to `/routing/import/:id`. The text itself is never stored, logged or put in a job. | Build README "Secrets". |
| Base | When `shadowrocket_base` is a URL that answers with a `[Rule]` section: "shadowrocket_base found · 41 lines, has a [Rule] section" and **Create a Shadowrocket config** (ticked) named `iphone` (`iphone-2` … when taken) following the import's list. A base without `[Rule]` or that fails: the reason, and no config offered. | mtvpn-import.md step 4. |
| Import | `POST /routing/import/:id` with the choices (ticked rows, convert choices, the list, the config's name and list) → `state = running`, job `routing.import` (queue `refresh`, 1 attempt, payload `{import_id}`, steps `services`, `lists`, `shadowrocket`). Step `services`: each ticked row in order, skipping rows that already have an outcome (a resume): **exists** → `reused` (found again by tag); **new** upstream → resolve (job timeouts) and create (`created`, or `failed` with the error: "not found on main, beta, russia"); **convert** → fetch the URL list, parse it (`sources.ParseList`, includes followed), create a custom service with the row's tag, name = tag, origin `import` (`converted`); each row in its own `Write`, its outcome saved in the import row. Step `lists`: each created, reused or converted service that passes the guard (`lists.CheckService`; a hit is that row's `skipped` with the guard's message and a recorded refusal) is added to the list in row order, skipping those already in it, in one `Write` (`list_updated{added}`, marked). Step `shadowrocket`: create the config (`routing.shadowrocket_created`), or record why not. Then `state = done`. A failed job sets `state = failed` (`OnFailed`). | mtvpn-import.md step 5. |
| Result | `/routing/import/:id` shows, per state: the preview form; "Importing…" with the job's step progress (polling every 2 s); the result: created, reused, converted, skipped (with reasons) and the config with a link, then the next steps "Point Shadowrocket at the new URL: open iphone" and (3e) "Add your routers". | mtvpn-import.md step 6. |
| Running again | Pasting the same file again makes a new preview whose rows are all **exists** and whose config name is taken (offered as `iphone-2`, unticked when a config with the same base content exists); importing it adds nothing to the list. | "Running the import again is harmless." |
| Prune | The prune job also deletes Shadowrocket fetches older than 90 days and import rows older than 30 days. | |
| Nav, search, names | Nav: **Shadowrocket** `/routing/shadowrocket`, order 60. Search: configs by name; meta "Shadowrocket config · Main". `SubjectNamer`: `shadowrocket` → name, `/routing/shadowrocket/<id>`. The lists page gains **Import from mtvpn…**. | |

	Rules []Rule

### `routing/mtvpn`

```go
type File struct {
	Services     []string
	ServiceLists []string
	Base         string   // shadowrocket_base

}

func ReadServiceList(text string) ([]string, error)

type Row struct {
	Selector   string `json:"selector"`
	Tag        string `json:"tag"`
	From       string `json:"from"`   // services, or the list's file name
	Status     string `json:"status"` // new, exists, invalid
	Problem    string `json:"problem,omitempty"`

	URL        bool   `json:"url"`

	Convert    bool   `json:"convert"`

	Error      string `json:"error,omitempty"`

}
type ListFailure struct{ URL, Error string }
type Shadowrocket struct {
	Offered bool   `json:"offered"`
	Lines   int    `json:"lines"`
	Problem string `json:"problem,omitempty"`
	Create  bool   `json:"create"`
	Name    string `json:"name"`
	ListID  int64  `json:"list_id"`
	Outcome string `json:"outcome,omitempty"` // created, failed
	Error   string `json:"error,omitempty"`
	ID      int64  `json:"id,omitempty"`
}
type Import struct {
	ID           int64
	State        string // preview, running, done, failed
	ListID       int64

	JobID        int64

}
type Choices struct {
	Include      map[int]bool // by row index
	Convert      map[int]bool
	ListID       int64

}

type Deps struct {
	DB           *db.DB
	Events       *events.Catalog
	Jobs         *jobs.System
	Services     *services.Service
	Lists        *lists.Service
	Shadowrocket *shadowrocket.Service
	Resolver     *sources.Resolver
	Fetch        *sources.Fetcher
	Now          func() time.Time
	Log          *slog.Logger
}
type Service struct{ /* … */ }
func New(d Deps) *Service

func (s *Service) Preview(ctx context.Context, text string, actor string) (int64, error) // a parse error is store.FieldErrors{"file": …}
func (s *Service) Get(ctx context.Context, id int64) (Import, error)
func (s *Service) Run(ctx context.Context, id int64, c Choices, actor string) (jobID int64, err error)
func (s *Service) JobTypes() []jobs.Type // routing.import
```

## Routes

| Method, path | What |
|---|---|
| `GET /routing/shadowrocket` | Configs |
| `GET /routing/shadowrocket/new`, `POST /routing/shadowrocket` | New config (multipart: `base_file` optional) → its page |
| `POST /routing/shadowrocket/import-base` | Import from URL (htmx: the textarea filled) |
| `GET /routing/shadowrocket/:id` | Config page |
| `GET /routing/shadowrocket/:id/url`, `/qr` | Reveal, QR fragments (`no-store`) |
| `GET /routing/shadowrocket/:id/output` | Download the rendered config (attachment) |
| `GET /routing/shadowrocket/:id/base`, `POST /routing/shadowrocket/:id/base` | Edit base config |
| `GET /routing/shadowrocket/:id/versions/:n`, `/versions/:n/diff` | View a version; diff against the one before |
| `POST /routing/shadowrocket/:id/versions/:n/restore` | Restore (strength 1) |
| `GET /routing/shadowrocket/:id/edit`, `POST /routing/shadowrocket/:id/edit` | List and policy |
| `POST /routing/shadowrocket/:id/token`, `/disable`, `/enable` | Regenerate, disable, enable |
| `GET /routing/shadowrocket/:id/delete`, `POST /routing/shadowrocket/:id/delete` | Delete → `/routing/shadowrocket` |
| `GET`, `HEAD /r/:token/:file` | The public config (`r.Public`) |
| `GET /routing/import`, `POST /routing/import` | Step 1: paste or upload → step 2 |
| `GET /routing/import/:id`, `POST /routing/import/:id` | Step 2 (preview, choices) → importing → step 3 (result) |
| `GET /routing/import/:id/status` | The progress area (htmx poll while running) |

## Pages

- **Shadowrocket** (`RP-Shadowrocket`): "A hosted config per phone: your base config with the routing list's rules added. The phone gets routing changes on its next refresh." and **New config** (primary, `n`). Rows: config (name; "base v3 · 3 412 rules"), list, policy, URL (always masked `…/r/••••••/iphone.conf`; the list never holds a token), last fetch ("20 min ago · Shadowrocket/2.2.62" or "never fetched"), a disabled marker. Empty state with **New config**.
- **New config**: a page styled as a dialog: name (help "Also the file name: iphone.conf"), routing list (the default preselected), rule policy (`PROXY`), base config (the CodeMirror field, a file input, and "Import from URL"), a note.
- **Config page** (`RP-Shadowrocket-config`): crumbs, the name, the line "routing list Main · policy PROXY · base config v3 · fetched 20 min ago" (or "disabled"), **Edit base config** (primary, `e`). Areas in this DOM order (phone: one column, URL first): bands (created, regenerated, disabled); **URL** (the masked field, Reveal, Copy, QR, and "In Shadowrocket: Config → + → paste the URL → Use config"); **What the phone gets** (the preview, **Download**); **Base config versions** (number, date, note, the current one marked; View, Diff, Restore); **Fetches**; **Actions** (Change routing list or policy…, Regenerate URL…, Disable… / Enable, Delete…, each with its one-line consequence); **Activity** (`shadowrocket:<id>`).
- **Edit base config**: the CodeMirror field with the current version, a note, "Import from URL", **Save** (makes vN+1 when changed) and **Cancel**; `ErrNoRule` shown above the textarea, the text kept (422).
- **Import from mtvpn** (`RP-Import`): crumbs **Lists / Import from mtvpn**; "Moves your mtvpn.yaml setup in once. It never contacts a router, and running it again adds nothing twice."; the step strip **1 · Paste**, **2 · Preview**, **3 · Result**. Step 1: a textarea and a file input, **Preview**. Step 2: counts ("23 selectors · 19 new services · 3 already exist, reused · 1 can't be read"), "ignored keys: shadowrocket_upload, shadowrocket_user, shadowrocket_password · never stored", failed lists, the rows (checkbox, selector and tag, from, status, the URL choice), "Into: Main ▾", the base box with its checkbox, name and list, **Import N services and 1 config** (primary, `⌘↵`), **Back**, **Cancel**, and "Main's targets re-sync after the import." Step 3: the result.

## Events

Recorded in 3d: `routing.shadowrocket_created`, `routing.shadowrocket_updated`, `routing.shadowrocket_deleted`; the import records `routing.service_added` (per new or converted service), `routing.list_updated` and `routing.shadowrocket_created` through the services it calls, and nothing of its own.

## Doc changes in the same commit

- `docs/processes/routing/shadowrocket-config.md`: a config can be deleted; within a service, rules another rule covers are dropped (mtvpn's rule); the header's time is the render time in UTC; the base's line endings are kept; the preview can be downloaded; the fetch log keeps 90 days.
- `docs/integrations/shadowrocket.md`: the merge as built (terminators kept, the CRLF case, the empty line before a following header).
- `docs/processes/routing/mtvpn-import.md`: the preview is stored without the file's text; one target list for every row; a service list must be a URL; a row whose tag exists is reused even when its selector differs; a guard hit skips that row; the default config name `iphone`.
- `docs/events.md#routing`: `routing.shadowrocket_deleted`; the Shadowrocket payloads.

## Checklist

Rendering, in `shadowrocket/render_test.go` and `rules_test.go` (pure):

- [ ] A base with `[General]`, `[Rule]` holding `RULE-SET,…` lines and `FINAL,DIRECT` → the block after the `RULE-SET` lines and before `FINAL,DIRECT`; every other byte unchanged — `TestInsertBeforeFinal`
- [ ] `[Rule]` without `FINAL`, followed by `[Host]` → the block at the end of `[Rule]`, then `FINAL,DIRECT`, then an empty line before `[Host]` — `TestNoFinalAddsOne`
- [ ] Trailing blank lines of `[Rule]` stay below the block; a CRLF base gets CRLF lines; comments and blank lines elsewhere are kept byte for byte — `TestBaseCopiedByteForByte`
- [ ] A base without `[Rule]` → `ErrNoRule` — `TestBaseNeedsRuleSection`
- [ ] "Main" with `anthropic` (suffix `anthropic.com`) and `mine` (exact `console.anthropic.com` only) → only `DOMAIN-SUFFIX,anthropic.com,PROXY`, and no block for `mine` — `TestOwnershipInRules`
- [ ] Policy `Proxy-Group-A` → every inserted rule ends with `,Proxy-Group-A`; the header names the list and the UTC minute — `TestPolicyAndHeader`
- [ ] Inside one service a name under its own suffix is dropped from the rules, unlike on routers — `TestRulesDropCoveredInsideService`

Configs, in `shadowrocket/` (`routingtest`):

- [ ] Create → version 1, a token, the URL `…/r/<token>/iphone.conf`; `shadowrocket_created`; a taken name, a bad name or policy refused — `configs_test.go` `TestCreateConfig`
- [ ] `GET` the URL → `200`, `text/plain; charset=utf-8`, `no-store`, the rendered body; recorded with IP and user agent; `HEAD` the same without a body and not recorded — `serve_test.go` `TestPublicFetch`
- [ ] An unknown token, a wrong file name and a bad token shape → the plain public `404`, nothing recorded — `serve_test.go` `TestUnknownTokenIs404`
- [ ] A snapshot accepted at 04:05 → the 04:06 fetch includes the change — `serve_test.go` `TestFetchSeesNewSnapshot`
- [ ] Regenerate the token → the old URL `404`s and the new one serves — `configs_test.go` `TestRegenerateToken`
- [ ] A disabled config → `404`; enabled again → served — `configs_test.go` `TestDisabledConfig`
- [ ] Restore version 2 while version 4 is current → version 5 with version 2's content; saving unchanged content makes no version and records nothing — `versions_test.go` `TestRestoreMakesNewVersion`
- [ ] The token never appears in an event, a log line (the request log writes `/r/•••/iphone.conf`) or the list page — `serve_test.go` `TestTokenStaysOnItsPage`
- [ ] Deleting a list moves its configs to the chosen list — `configs_test.go` `TestListDeleteMovesConfigs`

Import, in `mtvpn/`:

- [ ] `Parse`: scalars, quoted values, lists, comments, an empty `services:`; a list item without a key and a line without `:` are errors naming only the line number; unknown keys are listed by name and their values are not in `File` — `parse_test.go` `TestParseMtvpnFormat`
- [ ] `ReadServiceList` drops `- `, comments at the start or after whitespace (not inside a URL), `key:` lines; whitespace inside a line is an error; an empty list is an error — `lists_test.go` `TestReadServiceList`
- [ ] Today's `mtvpn.yaml` shape (one service list, one raw-URL service, a Shadowrocket base, upload credentials) → the list's selectors plus `tunneled-domains` imported into "Main" and a config created; the password's value is in no table, job payload, event or log line — `run_test.go` `TestImportTodaysFile`
- [ ] `services: [anthropic]` and a list containing `v2fly:anthropic` → one row `v2fly:anthropic`, tag `anthropic` — `preview_test.go` `TestDedupByTagFirstSpellingWins`
- [ ] `mine=https://…/list.txt` → a URL row with tag `mine` — `preview_test.go` `TestNamedURLRow`
- [ ] A `service_lists` URL answering `404` → reported; the other selectors stay importable — `preview_test.go` `TestFailingServiceList`
- [ ] `iplist:nosuchsite` → `failed` "not found on main, beta, russia"; the rest imported — `run_test.go` `TestUnresolvableSelectorSkipped`
- [ ] **Copy into a custom service** for `tunneled-domains` → a custom service with the file's names normalised, origin `import`; the URL isn't fetched again by any refresh — `run_test.go` `TestConvertToCustom`
- [ ] Importing the same file twice → the second preview shows every row as existing and the import adds nothing — `run_test.go` `TestImportTwiceAddsNothing`
- [ ] A file with `foo: bar` → `foo` listed as ignored — `preview_test.go` `TestUnknownKeysIgnored`
- [ ] A row whose service trips the guard is skipped with the guard's message; the others are added — `run_test.go` `TestGuardSkipsImportedRow`
- [ ] An import cut short after two rows resumes without creating them twice — `run_test.go` `TestImportResumes`

Pages, in `pages/shadowrocket_test.go` and `pages/import_test.go`:

- [ ] The configs list never contains a token; the config page shows the masked URL, Reveal and QR fragments with `no-store`, the preview, versions, fetches, actions and activity — `TestShadowrocketPages`
- [ ] New config from pasted text, from an uploaded file and from **Import from URL**; `ErrNoRule` shown in place (422) with the text kept; the new-config and edit pages load the editor bundle and mark the field `data-code="shadowrocket"`, and the posted textarea is what is saved — `TestNewConfigPage`
- [ ] The import walks paste → preview → importing (polling) → result; the lists page links it and the list page shows the config as a target — `TestImportPages`
